active_reply_percent.description: Chance to join each ordinary QQ group message, from 0 to 30 percent.

natural_chat_style.description: Keep QQ replies concise and conversational instead of assistant-like.

forget_expired_negative_context.description: Drop older hostile or negative exchanges from model context while preserving the current exchange.

recent_negative_context_messages.description: Recent context messages allowed to retain short-term negative context, from 0 to 20.
